description: Run container services next to a site, from any public image: the user's own server (running code from the site's source tree), a database such as Postgres or MySQL, Redis, or workers, each in a gVisor sandbox. The call applies the whole config: services missing from it are stopped (their volumes are kept) and the others restart, picking up new source files. It waits until every service is ready and returns per-service status; if one is not ready, call get_app_status with logs. One service may be public: it serves the site's HTTP traffic on its port. Use "${generated:NAME}" for database passwords. API keys and other outside secrets never go in the config, the source or the chat: the user adds them in the VibeDeploy dashboard (site Settings, Secrets) and every service receives them as environment variables. Per site: up to 6 services, 2048Mi memory and 2000m CPU in total, 4 volumes, 3Gi storage. Container volumes are not included in snapshots yet.

config.description: The app config; omit it to use vibedeploy.json from the site's source tree. Shape: {"services":{"<name>":{"image":"postgres:16-alpine","port":5432,"public":false,"env":{"KEY":"value"},"volumes":{"/var/lib/postgresql/data":"1Gi"},"command":[],"args":[],"workingDir":"/app","source":false,"sourcePath":"/app","memory":"256Mi","cpu":"500m"}}}. Services reach each other by name (host "db"). "source":true copies the source tree into sourcePath on every start, e.g. {"image":"node:22-alpine","source":true,"command":["sh","-c","npm ci && node server.js"],"port":3000,"public":true}. "$(OTHER)" embeds an earlier env var of the same service, e.g. "DATABASE_URL":"postgres://app:$(DB_PASSWORD)@db:5432/app". For Postgres set PGDATA to a subdirectory of the volume.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: deploy_app
title: Run container services (server, database, workers) for a site
